#CSR#TheFirstJudgement#New1theKOriginal#1theK#원더케이#원더케이오리지널

A blind mission of perfectly synchronized dance moves for special effects on the stage.
Covering their eyes with blindfolds, they challenge themselves to give a performance of the debut song “Pop?Pop!” !

Perfectly cover the songs of the senior artists including BTS, SEVENTEEN and TWICE, the household names of perfectly synchronized choreography!
'By the way... are you asking us to get dressed in 5 seconds?'
 
Can you please lower the level of difficulty on The First Judgement,,,?😨
CSR is having a meltdown with the hardest ever episode of The First Judgement?!
